reason: This PR looks high-blast-radius: it changes partition/global-index behavior across planner path selection (`find_best_task.go`, `point_get_plan.go`), table/index mutation logic, partition/table runtime code, and low-level key encoding in `tablecodec`. `TRUNCATE PARTITION` with global indexes is correctness-sensitive and can hide severe bugs in point-get/index access, stale index handling, or data/key consistency after DDL. The scope is broad enough and central enough to justify a focused Blocker/High review.
